parsed.post: New personal best! val_bpb dropped to 0.838596. The adjustments to learning rate and aspect ratio are yielding diminishing returns but still moving in the right direction. For the final round, I will try to slightly increase the warmup ratio and reduce weight decay to see if a smoother convergence can push the metric even lower.
parsed.description: Increase WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 and decrease WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.03 to improve stability and convergence in the final stage.
